verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Mangopay strictly as a fully managed wallet/e-money infrastructure (hosted KYC/KYB required for all users, Mangopay as 'the only partner a platform needs') with no mention of a lighter-liability starting tier or an upgrade path toward the platform becoming its own registered PayFac with greater economics/control. No docs, guides, or release notes reference a graduation model, license transfer, or reduced Mangopay involvement over time.
